zh: 本页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73P 的全部 132 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–I 依次处理冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递、移动剖面增益、非线性相对放大、平面固定距离偏离与零窗口作用量边界。R0.73J 认证无黏连续谱支，R0.73K 闭合参数一致的黏性 rank-one 谱支，R0.73L 把冻结谱支升级为真实非自治 selected action；R0.73M 再用完整 action 指定种子，并在固定物理时刻闭合二维非线性固定距离偏离。背景随 \(\Lambda\) 改变，轨道留在精确二维不变子空间；prefactor 极限、两项 WKB、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。 R0.73M 证明：当 \(\Lambda\to\infty\) 且背景随之改变时，按完整作用量 缩小的平面扰动可以在固定时刻保持固定阶输出。R0.73N 补上固定成员审计： 任意共存强解满足有限累积应变控制；平面扰动全局满足 \(L^2\) 稳定估计； 足够小的全三维 \(H^3\) 扰动落在正的全局强解稳定管内。因此，R0.73M 中的量词顺序不能交换为一个固定背景上的任意小输入、固定距离逃逸。 R0.73O 关闭了已知全局无强迫背景上的 \(H^3\)-小扰动不稳定路线：每条轨道最终衰减，累积 \(H^4\) 作用量有限，并有一个对所有起始时刻有效的正稳定半径。强迫对照保留无限累积应变，并由平面方向给出全局光滑、初始 \(H^3\) 趋零而输出固定 \(L^2\) 逃逸的见证。 R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。
en: From R0.61 through R0.73P, this page retains all 132 nodes. R0.61–R0.69W proceeds from reduced recurrence to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, the critical ledger, internal entry, and complete-root boundaries; R0.72A–R0.73B handles strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the full linear Fourier--Leray line; R0.73C–I treats, in order, frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of viscous spectral clusters, transfer into a fixed positive half-plane, moving-profile gain, nonlinear relative amplification, planar fixed-distance deviation, and the zero-window action boundary. R0.73J certifies an inviscid continuous-spectrum branch, R0.73K closes a parameter-consistent viscous rank-one spectral branch, and R0.73L upgrades the frozen spectral branch to the genuine nonautonomous selected action; R0.73M then uses the full action to prescribe the seed and closes two-dimensional nonlinear fixed-distance deviation at a fixed physical time. The background varies with \(\Lambda\), and the orbit remains in the exact two-dimensional invariant subspace; no extrapolation is made to the prefactor limit, two-term WKB, a fixed background, transverse three-dimensional dynamics, singularity formation, or Clay. R0.73M proves that, as \(\Lambda\to\infty\) with the background varying accordingly, planar perturbations scaled down by the full action can retain fixed-order output at a fixed time. R0.73N adds the fixed-member audit: every coexisting strong solution satisfies finite cumulative-strain control; planar perturbations satisfy a global \(L^2\) stability estimate; and sufficiently small fully three-dimensional \(H^3\) perturbations lie inside a positive global strong-solution stability tube. Therefore, the quantifier order in R0.73M cannot be exchanged for arbitrarily small input and fixed-distance escape on one fixed background. R0.73O closes the instability route based on \(H^3\)-small perturbations around known global unforced backgrounds: every orbit eventually decays, the cumulative \(H^4\) action is finite, and a positive stability radius is valid for every starting time. The forced comparison retains infinite cumulative strain and, in the planar direction, provides a globally smooth witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output exhibits a fixed \(L^2\) escape. R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and it permits smooth perturbations with \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes with the reference orbit; what remains uncrossed is the preceding early weak interval.

zh: 不能把 132 个节点或 94 个公开版本解释成 Clay 完成比例。N^-1/2 只对 Fourier 范数换算锐利，不是 Navier--Stokes 动力学必要阈值。无频率条件的早期强正则、有限时奇性和任意初值全局正则性仍为 OPEN。
en: The 132 nodes or 94 public releases must not be interpreted as a Clay completion percentage. N^-1/2 is sharp only for Fourier norm conversion; it is not a necessary threshold for Navier--Stokes dynamics. Early strong regularity without a frequency condition, finite-time singularity formation, and global regularity for arbitrary initial data remain OPEN.

zh: R0.73P 关闭了固定全局强轨道周围的临界稳定与带限输入接口：临界管对所有起始时刻有效，\(N^{-1/2}\) 指数对范数转移精确，并允许 \(L^2\) 趋零而 \(H^3\) 发散的光滑扰动。能量球内所有弱分支在共同延迟后正则并相对参考轨道同步；不能跨越的部分是此前的早期弱区间。 下一关是 R0.73Q：检查相对热流条件、频率包络和临界 Besov 拓扑能否形成严格大于 \(H^{1/2}\) 球、同时仍可全时段拼接的稳定域，并先完成 Kato、Koch--Tataru、Iftimie、Gallagher 与 Mucha 路线的碰撞审计。
en: R0.73P closes the critical-stability and band-limited-input interfaces around a fixed global strong orbit: the critical tube is valid for every starting time, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and it permits smooth perturbations with \(L^2\) tending to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. Every weak branch in the energy ball becomes regular after a common delay and synchronizes with the reference orbit; what remains uncrossed is the preceding early weak interval. The next gate is R0.73Q: examine whether relative heat-flow conditions, frequency envelopes, and critical Besov topologies can form a stability domain strictly larger than the \(H^{1/2}\) ball while remaining compatible with patching across the full time interval, and first complete a collision audit of the Kato, Koch--Tataru, Iftimie, Gallagher, and Mucha routes.
